description: The main window's application commands, allowed for the configured production origin and local development content. Keep remote.urls aligned with control_plane::DEFAULT_BASE_URL. Marketplace login windows receive no grant. notification:default is here rather than in default.json because on Android the main window is this remote origin, and the notification plugin's own page script asks is_permission_granted on every load; without the grant that call is a rejected promise in every page's log.
